newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept raw material investment up 24.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept raw material investment up 24.9 pct.

text.p: China's investment in its raw materials industry was 84.28 billion yuan ($10.15 billion) in January to September, up 24.9 percent from the same period a year ago, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday. Investment in the chemicals industry was 42.05 billion yuan in the first nine months, a rise of 33.1 percent compared with the year-ago period, Xinhua quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as showing.
China poured 33.18 billion yuan into the metallurgy sector in the period, up 17.3 percent, the agency said.
Non-ferrous metals investment rose 17.6 percent to 8.66 billion yuan, it said. It gave no further details.
